reference.question: The slope of the tangent line to the curve \(y=x^2\) at the point \((1,1)\) is \(2\). What is the \(y\)-intercept of the tangent line?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Use the point and slope

\(y-1=2(x-1)\). When \(x=0\), \(y=-1\).
